Nina Park: Heads up for Aug close 1 - we've got two items: late customer usage that didn't hit invoices and a pricing experiment that auto-issued usage credits. Need consensus on accrual approach. Summary sheet: https://tiny.redwood/close/2151
Owen Brooks: Are we talking about unbilled revenue or a timing deferral? if usage occurred in Aug, it's unbilled AR accrual.
Nina Park: Usage occurred in Aug. Estimated gross unbilled = $63,800 across three customers. Experiment credits = $9,600.
Sophie Kim: My reading of policy: net expected credits against the accrual if they are contractually tied or programmatic. Are these credits reversible?
Nina Park: Product confirms credits are experiment-driven invoice adjustments (tag EXP-AUG-02) and expected to apply at billing. They are not refundable.
Owen Brooks: Draft JE (net):
```
DR 1300 Unbilled AR 54,200
CR 4000 Revenue - Usage 54,200
Memo: Accrual for Aug unbilled usage net of experiment credits (EXP-AUG-02)
```
Sophie Kim: Please attach per-customer detail with experiment tag and the script output used to estimate usage. auditors like to see the logs.
billing-bot: Upload: exp_export_EXP-AUG-02.csv (received 2151236800).
CFO_Jess: Methodology approved. Send consolidated backup (per-customer calc + experiment export + JE math) to me by EOD for sign-off. If net accrual >50k confirm routing; otherwise team lead approval ok.
Nina Park: Will route now. Plan: post journal tomorrow AM for $54,200 after backups attached and tag close-pack PR #398. Any objections?
Owen Brooks: :thumbsup: go ahead.
Sophie Kim: Adding a one-line disclosure to the close notes re: programmatic credits and estimation method.
__notes: Typical short Slack thread discussing month-end accrual for unbilled usage impacted by a pricing experiment. Includes JE snippet, upload notice, and CFO approval request.
